# FAQ-019 Engineering FAQ #19

Revision: Rev A

Question: What lubricant part number is specified for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03)?
Answer: The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is CFW-LUB-159. Refer to ECN-2026-019 for the basis of the change and to maintenance SOPs for handling.

Question: What is the system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03)?
Answer: The system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 295 bar. Confirm pressure setpoints with the hydraulic control schematic in MM-P1-L4-CN01-S2 before commissioning.

Question: What is the maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01)?
Answer: The maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is 995 mm. Check setup drawings and rolling tooling clearances documented in ECN-2026-019.

Question: What is the specified chuck jaw bolt torque for Heat Treat CNC turning center #1 (EQ-P1-L4-CN01)?
Answer: The chuck jaw bolt torque for Heat Treat CNC turning center #1 (EQ-P1-L4-CN01) is 90 N·m. Use a calibrated torque wrench and follow the tightening sequence in MM-P1-L4-CN01-S2.

Question: What lubricant part number is specified for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01)?
Answer: The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is CFW-LUB-463. Verify on-site stock and order per SB-1008 procedures.

Related documents: ECN-2026-019, MM-P1-L4-CN01-S2, SB-1008.
